question: At a fixed 250 ms X11 hold deadline, does doing one full-frame capture before KeyRelease materially extend application-observed hold duration compared with sending KeyRelease before the same capture?
fixture: Xvfb 1024x768x24 + Openbox + rendered Tk checkerboard + XTEST w key

conditions.release_first: at the 250 ms deadline send KeyRelease+sync, then take one full-frame Pillow ImageGrab
conditions.capture_first: at the same deadline take one full-frame Pillow ImageGrab, then send KeyRelease+sync

primary_metric: paired capture_first-minus-release_first application-observed press-to-release duration in ms

decision.boundary_capture_cost_candidate: median paired delta >= 5 ms OR p95 paired delta >= 10 ms
decision.reject_as_tens_ms_explanation: median paired delta < 5 ms AND p95 paired delta < 10 ms

secondary_descriptive: compare paired delay with capture-first capture duration; no extra decision gate
construction_smoke: 2 pairs only, excluded from formal aggregation; observed median delta 4.6682825 ms
scope: development mechanism isolation only; no ViZDoom, gameplay efficacy, model, planner, renewal, or shared-runtime claim
